notes: T16/§14.6: a records/ file exceeds MAX_RECORD_BYTES (1,048,576) but the manifest itself is readable and structurally valid, so the failure is found at the records-listing stage: container invalid E_JSON_SIZE, records [], manifest-derived fields filled (record_count 1, manifest_digest set) and input identifies the raw manifest bytes (the two-tier rule). The oversize file is 1,048,577 bytes.
